name: xstate-kit
description: XState v5 expert toolkit: author statecharts, test, React-wire, persist, live-inspect, and 14-format diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: Author, test, persist, inspect, visualize, and React-wire XState v5 statecharts.
interface.longDescription: Author typed XState v5 statecharts with compound, parallel, and history states; test them with model-based path coverage and actor-level mocking; wire them into React; persist and rehydrate running actors; live-inspect transitions with @statelyai/inspect; and export any machine to 14 graph/diagram formats including Mermaid, DOT, xyflow, and GraphML.
defaultPrompt: Write an XState v5 checkout machine
